reference_cohort_info_part.note: This study uses the NOMIS (NOrmative Morphometry Image Statistics) software (Potvin et al., 2022, 2017, 2016), a pre-trained normative model based on n=6909 healthy adults aged 18-100. The normative model was not constructed within this paper; the authors applied the existing NOMIS tool to their CUD participants. Per extraction guidelines, RCI-1 through RCI-7 extraction is not required for Pre-trained studies.
